finalText:
All 4 tests pass.

Root cause: `processOrder` acquired a pool connection but only released it on the success path, skipping `finally`. Every failed order (bad payload, validation error) permanently dropped a connection. At 2am enough order failures piled up to exhaust the pool and take the service down — matches `worker.log` showing `order-4013 failed: invalid order payload` with no matching release line.

Fixed by wrapping the run call in try/finally, same pattern already used correctly in `handlers/api.js`. Nothing left to do — no further action needed.
